audience.text: Developers building .NET 8+ applications who need to generate, modify, and export Excel workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel or native Office installations.

capabilities.text: Create new workbooks and modify existing ones using Workbook, Worksheet, Cells, and Cell APIs to set values, formulas, and formatting.
capabilities.title: Create and edit workbooks

capabilities.text: Apply styles including fonts, colors, fills, borders, alignment, and locking to cells and ranges using Style and related APIs.
capabilities.title: Apply cell and range styling

capabilities.text: Load potentially corrupted Excel files using LoadOptions with repair flags and inspect LoadDiagnostics for data loss risk.
capabilities.title: Load malformed files with diagnostics

capabilities.text: Export workbooks to PDF format using PdfSaveOptions or SaveFormat.Pdf.
capabilities.title: Export to PDF

capabilities.text: Configure filters, tables, validations, conditional formatting, hyperlinks, defined names, comments, pictures, shapes, charts, and page setup.
capabilities.title: Configure worksheet features

limitations.text: Only .xlsx is supported as the spreadsheet file format for load and save.
The library stores formulas but does not include a formula calculation engine.
PDF export is supported, but there is no general HTML export or image export API.
Macros, VBA, and pivot tables are outside the supported public API surface.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook creation and modification in .NET without Microsoft Excel dependencies.
Supports loading malformed Excel files with repair options and diagnostic reporting.
Provides Excel-to-PDF export capability using a built-in renderer.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for .NET is an MIT-licensed .NET 8+ library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks and exporting them to PDF.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported .xlsx features is not fully enumerated in the fact dossier.
Whether conditional formatting rules are evaluated or only stored is not specified.
The behavior of repair options on specific corruption types is not detailed.
The extent of chart rendering fidelity in PDF export is not specified.
Whether validation rules are enforced or only stored is not stated.
The support status of Excel tables (ListObject) beyond basic CRUD is unclear.
The behavior of workbook/worksheet protection in FOSS is not detailed.
Whether formula parsing is supported without calculation is not explicitly stated.

workflows.name: Create and save workbook
workflows.text: Create a new workbook, populate cells with values and formulas, apply header styling, and save as .xlsx and PDF.

workflows.name: Load and repair workbook
workflows.text: Load a potentially malformed workbook using LoadOptions with repair flags, inspect diagnostics for data loss risk, then save the repaired workbook.
